entities.name: Francisco José Millán Mon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Francisco José Millán Mon is a Spanish politician and
Member of the European Parliament with the People's Party, part of the European People's Party. Mon was born in Pontevedra. He sits on the European Parliament's Committee on Foreign Affairs, and is a substitute for the Committee on Development and a member of the
Delegation to the Euro-Mediterranean Parliamentary Assembly.
